name: Rhythm Punch
summary:
Rhythm Punch is a mixed reality experience that transforms your real environment into an interactive space where music drives every move. Punch targets in sync with the beat, build combos, and improve your precision while developing reflexes, coordination, and physical endurance.

Designed to be both intuitive and challenging, the game adapts to players looking for fun as well as those seeking an active workout. Every hit matters, and every miss is a chance to refine your timing and control.
